mentions.name: Font of Web
mentions.description: A search engine for real-world web design that sources design elements directly from live websites instead of curated mockups or award showcases. The community clips specific elements (navbars, pricing cards, dashboards) rather than full pages, and each clip is enriched with metadata such as fonts, color palettes, and the original domain. Search works across metadata, natural language queries (e.g. 'minimalist fintech dashboard'), and visual similarity, so users can find results by text or image. A Chrome extension lets users snip and save elements from any site.
mentions.problem: Most design inspiration sites (Dribbble, Awwwards, Mobbin) lean on curated mockups and polished showcases that don't reflect what most production websites actually look like.
mentions.audience: Designers and frontend engineers; the author asks whether it fits into their workflow
